posts.t:
Balance occurs when neither sellers nor buyers are motivated to move price beyond a range. We see this balance on our charts in the form of a consolidation or range. These occur on all time frames. Eventually either sellers or buyers will become impatient and move price beyond the range. If there is extreme imbalance as shown here then the breakout will be sudden and violent. These violent moves out of these consolidations or clusters create new demand or supply. In this case new demand was created. So now we are very interested in this area when price moves away for some time then returns.

Rosa wrote: Hi, But where there is balance? Can you show me it on chart?

Not sure if I completely understand your question but maybe this will help. On this M5 chart there are a couple of bullish flags. They are bullish because they occur in an uptrend. Flags are a form of consolidation or balance although often the flag will lean towards bulls or bears but there is no decisive direction. Once the flag breaks then we can have a zone created. I think most wait for price to break above the high or low of the flag and then this becomes a DP as shown. You can see later how price reacts to these DPs.

I show a demand zone that price did not reach but it did enter into the area of the large bullish M5 candle and shot up dramatically denoting strong demand.

posts.t:
Hi Rosa.

Regarding the Decision Point. Try to think about the definition of a decision point. I say when One side of Bull or Bears are winning and moving price further in their direction. We spot the DP where we see the last opposing power. Exp.: if Bulls win, we set the DP to where we see the last Seller. Usually that would be at the opening of the opposition bar.

When either side wins a battle, it is called a Decision - a decision to move to the next level. What I think was confusing you, is that the next level did not set new high. it is not suppose to. But the decision was made to move higher.

For the DP not creating new High, it was a hint sent to you, to tell you possible sellers are gaining strength. when last leg DP was broken, they were sending a louder message about their intentions for more selling.

This is how I would look at it.

Hope I am being more clear this time.

posts.t:
Hope this chart helps. The red DP I think is the one Benhur was referring to. The large bearish candle reacted to the red DP. It moved up forming the small bull candle you are referring to. This is PA telling you there is no bull strength to make a new high. When it breaks below the DP bull weakness is confirmed. Price moves down to the next DP in black. We get another bullish reaction but again no new high. Being in a large supply zone if you look to the left on daily and weekly we would anticipate this PA. I believe the formation here is a QM or reversal pattern.

Hindsight is 20/20 Rosa so although I can often analyze history pretty good I do have difficulty trading this stuff in real time. Hang in there. This is how you learn

One other thing Rosa. I tend to think you are expecting something to happen and when it doesn't you get frustrated. We must react to what is happening not what we think is going to happen. Always consider the other side of your plan.

posts.t:
I know we're beating this to death but I think the discussion is worthy. Plus if we get some of the senior traders to chime in then we all benefit.

When price breaks from a consolidation, range or cluster whether of short or long duration we have the makings of a potential DP. A clear break from a cluster with price moving clearly up or down with follow through is key. If there is no follow through then there really isn't a decision. If price stalls and moves back then IMO no decision was made. Price needs to engulf the previous price action and clearly break away.

I chose this area in the chart below to illustrate something. Notice 1 and 2 are clear areas where price broke up with a bullish engulfing (BE). The first or lower BE broke out of a larger cluster than the one in BE 2. But price IMO did not truly make a decision to go much higher. Price stalled before getting to 3. If price had broken above 3 then that to me is a real decision because price would have engulfed the bearish price action to the left. In this case price did not engulf the bearish price action to the left so no real decision. Now this is in the context of the time frame shown.

Having said all that above if you look at this on LTFs then in the context of LTFs these areas would probably be significant DPs.

Also I want to stress again that DPs occur on all time frames. You may be able to clarify the area on a LTF. Also more DPs will occur on LTFs.

وقتی قیمت از یک تثبیت، رنج یا خوشه — کوتاه‌مدت یا بلندمدت — می‌شکند، زمینهٔ یک DP بالقوه را داریم. شکست واضح از یک خوشه با حرکت قیمت به‌وضوح بالا یا پایین با تداوم حرکت کلیدی است. اگر تداوم حرکت نباشد واقعاً تصمیمی نیست. اگر قیمت بایستد و برگردد به نظرم هیچ تصمیمی گرفته نشده. قیمت باید رفتار قیمت قبلی را اینگالف کند و به‌وضوح جدا شود.

این ناحیه را در چارت زیر انتخاب کردم تا چیزی را نشان بدهم. توجه کن 1 و 2 نواحی روشنی هستند که قیمت با یک اینگالف صعودی (BE) به بالا شکست. BE اول یا پایین‌تر از خوشهٔ بزرگ‌تری نسبت به BE 2 شکست. اما قیمت به نظرم واقعاً تصمیم نگرفت خیلی بالاتر برود. قیمت قبل از رسیدن به 3 متوقف شد. اگر قیمت بالای 3 می‌شکست به نظرم آن تصمیم واقعی بود چون قیمت رفتار قیمت نزولی چپ را اینگالف کرده بود. در این مورد قیمت رفتار قیمت نزولی چپ را اینگالف نکرد پس تصمیم واقعی نیست. این در بافت تایم‌فریم نشان‌داده‌شده است.

با این‌همه که بالا گفتم، اگر این را روی LTF‌ها نگاه کنی، در بافت LTF‌ها این نواحی احتمالاً DP‌های مهمی خواهند بود.

همچنین می‌خواهم دوباره تأکید کنم که DP‌ها در همهٔ تایم‌فریم‌ها رخ می‌دهند. شاید بتوانی ناحیه را روی یک LTF مشخص کنی. همچنین DP‌های بیشتری روی LTF‌ها رخ می‌دهند.

Hi Hr,

When you have a fresh unspiked base and price leaves it with momentum than yes it can be seen as a good supply or demand zone. I explained all this in the sd article.

Please have a look at it. readthemarket.com/index.php/education/ma...-zones-levels-by-mel

However Hr, nothing is 100% and just trading zones blindly is alike gambling so we can use PA to see what price is telling us and then react on it's action.

I hope this helps, Mel
